data.narrative:
Slip Robotics is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer set of 4 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, spanning both Series B and Series C companies, alongside a broader competitive universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy, applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of $84M. Peer-median analysis across 4 robotics comparables—Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C)—yields a median of $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $1.8B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range from $71M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $854M. This disparity reflects material uncertainty about Slip Robotics' positioning relative to well-funded late-stage peers. The peer-median result assumes comparable market traction and investor appetite; the stage-progression result assumes more conservative capital deployment. Key variables affecting narrowing this range include Slip Robotics' revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to named peers.
